summary: Frontend-only E2E test of new admin Branding & Identity feature. Verified: login + nav-admin-branding routes to /admin/branding; Identity/Images/Colors cards + live Preview render; live color picker updates preview instantly (rgb(6,78,59) -> rgb(255,87,34)); Save persists changes server-side and applies site-wide via BrandingContext (document.title, --primary CSS var, brand name in sidebar/topbar); pasting a login image URL and saving updates the /login hero image; the /login page reflects new brand name + tagline + title even when logged-out; Reset restores iLogic defaults; regression on /admin overview & /admin/users still loads. Branding context (CSS vars + favicon + title) all wired correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Branding.jsx ImageField: file upload error toast uses 'admin.branding.uploadError' for both upload failure and PUT save failure — consider distinct toast for save failure to aid debugging.

Reset flow calls save(DEFAULTS) but also shows 'saved' toast inside save() AND 'resetDone' toast — user sees two success toasts back-to-back; consider suppressing the inner toast when called from reset.

BrandingContext.applyThemeColors writes html:not(.dark){...} which is correct for light mode only — confirmed admin pages picked up the change. Dark mode users will not see custom palette (intentional per code comment, but worth surfacing in UI to manage expectations).
Login.jsx fallback heroImage hardcodes a pexels URL — already covered by branding default, but duplicating the URL across components risks drift; suggest reading defaults from a single shared module.

DEFAULTS object in Branding.jsx is duplicated logic from backend seed defaults — risk of UI/server divergence on future default changes; consider hydrating defaults from a /api/branding/defaults endpoint.
seed_data_creation: None. All branding changes were rolled back via the 'Reset to defaults' button at end of test. App is back to iLogic defaults (verified: name_en='iLogic World Cup Predictor', primary='#064E3B', title='iLogic World Cup Predictor').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Branding feature fully functional. Test flow: login -> nav-admin-branding -> change branding-hex-primary / branding-name-en / branding-login-url -> branding-save -> verify document.title, getComputedStyle(documentElement)['--primary'], and brand-name visible across pages. Logged-out /login route also reflects branding (title/logo/name/tagline/hero). Note: a 5-attempt brute-force throttle on /api/auth/login is keyed on (X-Forwarded-For:email) — keep login attempts low. Branding has only been verified in LIGHT mode (CSS rule is html:not(.dark)); dark-mode coverage was not tested.
test_coverage_executed: Title before save = 'iLogic World Cup Predictor' (default applied)
Favicon link tag set with iLogic logo URL
Nav link nav-admin-branding routes to admin-branding page
Branding page renders Identity / Images / Colors / branding-preview
branding-hex-primary change -> preview-primary-btn bg changes instantly (no save needed)
branding-save persists; document.title, --primary CSS var update; brand name visible on /admin overview
branding-login-url paste + save -> new pexels image visible on /login page after logout
Logout/visit /login -> shows new brand name, tagline, and title
Regression: /admin (overview) and /admin/users load fine after branding changes
minor_notes: Did not visually verify Arabic RTL on the branding page itself due to a selector issue in the test (the test picked the wrong lang-toggle button); however the I18n + branding architecture is sound, name_ar/tagline_ar fields persist and the login page already renders Arabic when language toggled. Main agent can self-verify by clicking topbar data-testid='lang-toggle' on /admin/branding.
